🐕 Agilitybanan – här tävlar hundarna! Sk: 🐕 The agility course – this is where the dogs compete! Get a dog from the pet shop or the shelter, and you can run the course together.
AGILITYBANAN – TÄVLA MED DIN HUND: AGILITY COURSE – COMPETE WITH YOUR DOG
Hoppa över hindren och däcket, spring ge: Jump the hurdles and the tyre, run through the tunnel (don't jump!), press fast in the slalom and wait on the seesaw. Every run trains your dog – a well-trained dog runs faster.
